_说明: 最近两个版本（26.20、26.21）官方更新公告和英雄联盟 Wiki 的摘录。整理于 2026-10-24。这个环境打不开 leagueoflegends.com / Wiki 页面，内容来自网页搜索得到的原文摘录；我的英雄池条目由第二个检索员独立核对过。 2026-10-25 补充：他常用英雄（莉莉娅、猴子、男枪、潘森、破败之王）和他双排上单常用英雄（奎桑提、狼母、鳄鱼、加里奥）在 26.19–26.21 的改动，第二次独立检索核对过。

patches.release: 2026-10-21（欧美服上线；公告 10-20 发布；10-22 有一次只涉及韦鲁斯的版本中更新）

note: 只列出他常用的英雄、我的英雄池、装备/系统和资源刷新时间。“当前数值”类条目写的是现在的数值和最后一次改动的版本。

items.change: 被动（废料场泰坦）过热时的额外攻速：50–130% → 30–100%（随等级）。同时过热对野怪的伤害上限 65–150 → 90–175（打野补偿，不影响上路换血）。

items.subject: 铁血狼母（狼母）

items.subject: 海克斯火箭腰带
items.change: 技能急速 20 → 10；超音速主动伤害 100（+10% AP）→ 135（+15% AP）。和 AP 兰博有关。

items.subject: 实验性海克斯板甲
items.change: 超速效果对远程英雄只给 50%（原 70%）；近战不变。

items.subject: 狂妄
items.change: 分近战/远程：基础额外攻击力 12 → 15（近战）/ 10（远程）；远程每层 3 → 2，近战不变。对近战上单和近战打野是加强。

items.subject: 破垒者
items.change: 穿甲 22 → 18；塑形炸药伤害 50/25 → 40/20（近战/远程）；破坏效果持续时间 90 秒 → 基本不限。

items.subject: 上路职业任务：传送
items.change: 免费传送冷却 420 → 390 秒；上单任务强化后的传送 330–240 → 300–210 秒。

items.subject: 野区和资源
items.change: 26.20、26.21 没有找到野怪、惩戒、打野宠物、职业任务、大小龙/巢虫/先锋/男爵刷新时间或防御塔镀层的改动。

items.subject: 盲僧
items.change: W 金钟罩冷却 7 → 8 秒；R 猛龙摆尾基础伤害 175/400/625 → 150/350/550（+200% 额外攻击力不变）；修复 E 会显示被击中后才隐身的敌人。

items.subject: 德邦总管
items.change: Q 三重爪击额外攻击力系数 40% → 45%（Wiki 另列 E 的攻速系数调整，未在官方公告核实）。

items.subject: 齐天大圣
items.change: 被动 金刚不坏 每层护甲 6–10 → 4.5–10（随等级）；基础生命回复 3.5 → 5.5（削弱打野、补偿上路）。

items.subject: 披甲龙龟
items.change: W 防御姿态 护甲/魔抗系数 30/37.5/45/52.5/60% → 30/35/40/45/50%（Wiki 另有一条固定护甲改动，两者有冲突）。

items.subject: 狂厄蔷薇
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）Her ult SFX now uses the base-skin version when you play against her, for clarity. No balance change was found.

items.subject: 皮城女警
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）Power moves from late-game Headshot to early Q. Passive Headshot AD ratio goes from 60/80/100% to 60/70/80% (by level), and its crit scaling is reduced (official: 1% to 0.8% per point). Q Piltover Peacemaker base damage goes from 50/90/130/170/210 to 50/95/140/185/230 (per the official notes). The wiki also lists Ace in the Hole crit ratio reduced to 0-30% and AD growth 3.4 to 3.8, but those are unverified.

items.subject: 暴走萝莉
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）Base health goes from 630 to 610, and AD growth from 3.25 to 3. Riot wants her to be harder to snowball.

items.subject: 惩戒之箭
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）W Blighted Quiver rework toward ratios. On-hit base damage goes from 4/13/22/31/40 to 4/10/16/22/28, the bonus AD ratio from 15% to 20%, and the AP ratio from 25% to 30%. Per-stack damage goes from 3-5% to 2.5-4.5% max HP (+1.4% per 100 AP). The cooldown refund becomes 11%, increased by up to 70% based on Q channel time. The active missing-health damage is 6-10%, also increased by up to 70% from Q channel.

items.subject: 惩戒之箭
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）The base 26.21 changes added a bug where Q Piercing Arrow stopped dealing reduced damage to subsequent targets. That bug is fixed. As compensation, Q minimum base damage goes from 50/95/140/185/230 to 50/100/150/200/250.

items.subject: 赏金猎人
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）Buffed to offset the Hubris nerf. E Make It Rain base damage goes from 70/100/130/160/190 to 90/120/150/180/210 (+120% AP). R Bullet Time crit damage goes from 130% to 145%, and the bonus-crit scaling from 0.3% to 0.45%.

items.subject: 麦林炮手
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）Q Rapid Fire bonus attack speed goes from 60/75/90/105/120% to 40/60/80/100/120%. This slows her level-1 lane pressure.

items.subject: 诺克萨斯之手
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）Slight buff: Q Decimate cooldown is reduced. The wiki gives 9/8/7/6/5s to 9/7.75/6.5/5.25/4s. One search excerpt of the official notes instead gave 9/8/7/6/4s, which conflicts.

items.subject: 封魔剑魂
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）Q Mortal Steel AD ratio goes from 110% to 105% AD.

items.subject: 亡灵战神
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）Health growth goes from 87 to 95. R Unstoppable Onslaught base damage modifier (based on channel time) goes from 0-166.67% to 0-200%. Also a tooltip fix for its bonus AD scaling.

items.subject: 元素女皇
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）Partial revert of her 26.17 Q buff. Q Edge of Ixtal base damage goes from 80/110/140/170/200 to 70/100/130/160/190, with the +90% bonus AD ratio unchanged.

items.subject: 灰烬驱魔人
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）Mana and sustain are nerfed while scaling is buffed. Mana growth goes from 70 to 60. Soul Ignition mana cost goes from 50-70 to 60-80, and its grey-health floor from 40-200 to 20-200. The max grey-health health threshold goes from 150-450 to 100-500. Ashen Pursuit blink damage goes from 40/50/60/70/80 (+40% AP) to 40/55/70/85/100 (+50% AP).

items.subject: 发条魔灵
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）Late-game scaling buff. Q Command: Attack AP ratio goes from 55% to 60%, and W Command: Dissonance AP ratio from 80% to 85%.

items.subject: 符文法师
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）W Rune Prison AP ratio goes from 60% to 70%. Q Overload bonus move speed goes from 28-44% to 30-50%. Q flux bonus damage is reshaped from 15/40/65/90% to 10/40/70/100%. Riot says he wasn't rewarded enough for scaling after the 26.19 nerfs.

items.subject: 奥术先驱
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）Base move speed goes from 335 to 330. Q Siphon Power shield goes from 40-140 to 30-130 (by level), its AP ratio from 25% to 20%, and its duration from 2.5s to 2s.

items.subject: 沙漠皇帝
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）Mana growth goes from 40 to 50 per level, so he can contest lane more freely.

items.subject: 岩雀
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）E Unraveled Earth initial damage goes from 60/105/150/195/240 to 70/115/160/205/250, with its AP ratio from 60% to 70%. Detonation damage goes from 25/40/55/70/85 to 30/45/60/75/90 (+30% AP). The 225% monster-damage multiplier is unchanged.

items.subject: 虚空之眼
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）Passive Organic Deconstruction base damage goes from 35-180 to 35-205 (by level), and its AP ratio from 60% to 65%. These numbers come from the wiki only; the official excerpt was truncated.

items.subject: 瓦洛兰之盾
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）Partial revert: his spells now work on untargetable allies again. E Dazzle's exemption remains for Vanished allies, and the tooltip now says so.

items.subject: 卡牌大师
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）R Destiny now reveals untargetable units.

items.subject: 暮光星灵
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）Bug fix: Spell Thief could give her a 1000-damage Smite from a minion drop earlier than intended.

items.subject: 不落魔锋
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）Bug fix: The Darkin Glaive now deals damage if he enters revive mid-strike. There is no SR balance change; Arena separately changes his passive.

items.subject: 暴怒骑士
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）Listed in the 26.21 champion section under R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!. The listed change is an SFX clarity fix (base-skin ult SFX when you play against him), same as Briar's. The wiki's Kled page also shows larger ability changes, but they appear to come from older patches and are not attributed to 26.21.

items.subject: 永猎双子
items.change: W 狼灵狂热 对野怪伤害 150% → 165%；E 横生惧意 不能再对小型野怪使用，减速 1 → 1.5 秒（Wiki 另列冷却等改动，未核实）。

items.subject: 皎月女神
items.change: W 苍白之瀑 护盾的额外生命值系数 11% → 14%。

items.subject: 龙血武姬
items.change: 修复：R 能打断敌人的传送和引导；W 生效期间不能再次施放。

items.subject: 寒冰射手
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）AD growth goes from 3.5 to 3.

items.subject: 魔蛇之拥
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）Base health goes from 630 to 610, and base mana from 480 to 450, to curb her early laning.

items.subject: 狂暴之心
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）E Lightning Rush bonus attack speed goes from 40/50/60/70/80% to 50/60/70/80/90%, to help AD Kennen after the Rocketbelt change. The wiki also mentions a fix so he deals 65% damage to jungle monsters, which is unverified.

items.subject: 圣枪游侠
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）AD growth goes from 2.5 to 2.9, compensating for the bot-lane loss from the previous patch's mid/bot normalization.

items.subject: 铁铠冥魂
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）Q Obliterate base damage level scaling goes from +5 to +7 per level (0-45 to 0-63). The wiki also lists an R Realm of Death cooldown change from 140/120/100 to 120/110/100s, which is wiki-only.

items.subject: 万花通灵
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）Q Tangle-Barbs base damage goes from 70/105/140/175/210 to 80/115/150/185/220, as compensation for the Rocketbelt change.

items.subject: 炽炎雏龙
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）Super Scorcher Breath crit scaling goes from 25-55% to 25-60%. W Flap, Flap, Flap bonus magic damage goes from 8-12.8% to 8-14% (IE scaling from 0-1.44% to 0-1.8%). R MMOOOMMMM! base heal goes from 100/135/170 to 100/175/250, and its heal ratio from 50% to 75% bonus AD.

items.subject: 诺克萨斯统领
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）A moderate buff for Swain mid that also normalizes mid vs bot. Base MR goes from 31 to 34, and base armor from 25 to 23 (official). The wiki also lists W Vision of Empire cooldown from 22/21/20/19/18 to 20/19/18/17/16s, W damage from 70/105/140/175/210 to 70/115/160/205/250, and base MS from 335 to 325. Those wiki-only changes are unverified.

items.subject: 河流之王
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）Q Tongue Lash base heal goes from 10/15/20/25/30 to 10/20/30/40/50, because his sustain fell behind after support-item changes.

items.subject: 暗夜猎手
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）Base HP regen goes from 4 to 5.5, and regen growth from 0.5 to 0.4. Q Tumble mana cost goes from 46/42/38/34/30 to a flat 30.

items.subject: 不破之誓
items.change: （英文摘要，待翻译）Cultivation of Spirit passive and active on-hit base damage goes from 5/10/15/20/25 to 3/8/13/18/23, targeting the 'handshake hyperscaler' meta before Worlds. Slows from Arc of Judgment / Arc of Ruin no longer stack.

items.subject: 含羞蓓蕾
items.change: 基础护甲 22 → 24；R 夜阑谣 昏睡时间 2 → 2.5 秒（所有等级）。（26.19 在最近两个版本之前，因为和 26.20 的改动是连着的，一起列出）

items.subject: 含羞蓓蕾
items.change: R 夜阑谣 昏睡时间 2.5 → 2.5/2.75/3 秒（随等级）。官方说明这是 26.19 加强的后续。Wiki 片段里还出现过 R 冷却变化，与官方公告不一致，未采用；当前冷却以 Data Dragon 16.21.1 为准（150/130/110 秒）

items.subject: 含羞蓓蕾
items.change: 26.21 没有改动（Wiki 显示最后改动为 26.20）

items.subject: 纳祖芒荣耀
items.change: 26.21 没有改动

items.subject: 不屈之枪
items.change: 26.19–26.21 在召唤师峡谷都没有改动（Wiki 显示最后一次改动为 未查到；26.19–26.21 里只有经典模式/大乱斗/斗魂竞技场的改动，与排位无关）

items.subject: 正义巨像
items.change: 26.19–26.21 在召唤师峡谷都没有改动（Wiki 显示最后一次改动为 26.10；26.19–26.21 里只有经典模式/大乱斗/斗魂竞技场的改动，与排位无关）
